title: Welcome from Prof. Dr. Renata Chałas Chair of the Local Organising Committee
html:
Renata Chałas

Professor Renata Chałas, MD, PhD is a Head of the Department of Oral Medicine and Dean of the Faculty of Medical Dentistry for the terms of 2020-2024 and 2024-2028 at the Medical University of Lublin, Poland. She is a specialist in general dentistry (I°), conservative dentistry (II°) and in periodontology.

Dear ADEE Friends

It is my great pleasure to be as Dean of the Faculty of Medical Dentistry and Head of the Department of Oral Medicine at the Medical University of Lublin, Poland to be able to welcome you all to Lublin for ADEE 2027 from 23 - 27 August. It has been an aspiration of the Lublin team to bring ADEE to our city for many years and we are delighted that the ADEE Board has entrusted us to delivery ADEE 2027, ADEE’s first meeting in Poland since Kraków in 2006.

While a small city, Lublin is full of charm and character, blending history and heritage with science and innovation. It is for this reason we have selected our theme as ‘Future Skills, Enduring Values’. During ADEE 2027 we will feature speakers and workshops we hope will inspire you to evolve your skills and curriculum, while at the same time staying through to our core values as responsible, ethical and trusted academics.

At the Medical University of Lublin, we believe in education that transforms dentistry. We hope that the ADEE Annual Meeting 2027 in Lublin unites European dental education at the intersection of heritage and innovation. We gather as educators, researchers, and practitioners to advance evidence-based teaching and future competencies. This conference bridges scientific knowledge with practical excellence, fostering collaboration across borders and disciplines.

We look forward to providing international dental educators with the opportunity to showcase their work focused on the meeting theme in the selected oral presentations and we are confident of great opportunities for connecting and networking with colleagues from all the world.

During your time with us we look forward to helping you explore our beautiful city and have scheduled some exciting social events to help you enjoy and gain benefit from our time together. Please explore the outline schedule online, and the ensure you keep informed as more details become available by subscribing to the ADEE newsletter.

The local organising committee and the rest of the dental team in Lublin look forward to seeing you soon and until then do keep an eye to the website for more information as it becomes available.
